nativeMachineDefinition.edition: Khamsin — final Blade Wolf DLC 2013 integrated pilot/mecha
nativeMachineDefinition.sourceQualification: Source-led articulated 2D adaptation of the stated original edition, not an absolute 1:1 certificate. Original PNG bytes untouched; source clipping occurs only during Canvas rendering. Final anthracite/red DLC concept and final gameplay captures establish integrated pilot, claw feet, chainsaw axe and axe propulsion. Hidden rear joints are interpreted. Opposite-facing source is an independent drawing; wrong-direction feet on right sheet are preserved but not used, replaced by two independently generated right-facing feet. Existing Core UID, moves, collider and health are unchanged; no new Khamsin encounter was found in the three-boss MGR module.
